verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official open-source CLI (newrelic-cli) supporting entity search, tagging, and deployment markers, confirmed by GitHub repo evidence and a probe. However, the evidence doesn't show AI-native-specific CLI features (e.g., natural-language querying or agentic workflows) built into the CLI itself — those capabilities are documented for the separate MCP server/AI assistant, not the CLI. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native design in the CLI itself (e.g., NRQL/AI query support, agent-friendly output modes), independent hands-on reviews of the CLI's utility.
